html:
To have memorable cruises in Ha Long on 5- and 6-star boats, join Vietlook Trave to travel to Ha Long today to experience the most interesting things when sitting on surfing boats. On the clear blue water and through famous landscapes, enjoying delicious dishes with Asian and European flavors will bring visitors the most perfect vacation.

Joining the cruise, visitors can enjoy delicious dishes right at the luxury restaurant on the boat. The restaurant on the Ha Long cruise not only gives tourists a luxurious and classy space but also enjoys delicious food. From affordable to high-end to suit every traveler’s needs.

When enjoying delicious dishes, especially fresh seafood dishes of the bay, visitors can enjoy delicious dishes on the yacht while admiring the peaceful scenery, which will bring visitors a feeling of enjoyment.

Choose dishes while on a cruise

What to eat while on a cruise, this is a question asked by many tourists, especially those going on a cruise for the first time, so don’t worry too much because there are many delicious dishes at the restaurant on the ship. Convenient for tourists to choose from, and has full services for visitors to choose from including private rooms, birthday parties….

Which season is best to go on a Ha Long cruise?

Ha Long’s weather will change with each season, but to have the most beautiful cruise you should go from mid-April to June. At this time, the weather is clear, the wind is light, the sea is calm, very suitable for a sightseeing trip. on the beach, and this is also the occasion for students to have summer vacation, so there are quite a lot of tourists traveling to Ha Long. To be proactive about the trip, you should book a tour early to get the most attractive price. You should not travel to Ha Long in September. There are storms in July and August. In winter, the weather in Ha Long is quite cold.

To have a trip to Ha Long with your family, you should experience a 5-star cruise, with outstanding service, airy space and enjoying delicious food right on the cruise will bring visitors the perfect vacation. best.

Experiencing a cruise on Ha Long Bay, you don’t need to spend too much time, just experience 2 days 1 night on a 5 or 6 star cruise and you will feel the beauty of the bay, and fun activities such as cooking, reading books…

So it can be said that Ha Long Bay is one of the famous tourist destinations chosen by many tourists, so to be proactive in your trip you should proactively book a tour early, and you will receive the most favorable price, which will be convenient. Convenient for your visit.
